## Vegetable-forward picks in Salt Lake County

If you like vegetables, here are the highest-rated vegetarian/vegan-tagged spots in Salt Lake County (filtered to places with at least 40 reviews, so ratings are reliable):

1. **Buds** (Salt Lake City) — 4.9★, 818 reviews — tagged both vegetarian and vegan
2. **Cafe Shambala** (Salt Lake City) — 4.8★, 418 reviews — Tibetan/Himalayan, vegetarian-friendly
3. **Vegan Bowl** (West Jordan) — 4.8★, 628 reviews — build-your-own veggie/vegan bowls
4. **Rawtopia Living Cuisine and Beyond** (Millcreek) — 4.8★, 495 reviews — raw, plant-forward menu
5. **Curry Up Now** (Salt Lake City) — 4.8★, 148 reviews — Indian street food with strong veg options
6. **Mahider Ethiopian Restaurant & Market** (Salt Lake City) — 4.7★, 608 reviews — Ethiopian cuisine is naturally veggie-rich (lentils, greens, veggie combos)
7. **Sri Balaji Caffe** (West Jordan) — 4.7★, 398 reviews — South Indian vegetarian
8. **Diversion Social Eatery** (Salt Lake City) — 4.7★, 338 reviews
9. **CoreLife Eatery** (multiple SLC/Sandy locations) — 4.5–4.6★, 600–1,000+ reviews each — salad/grain-bowl chain, veggie-forward by design
10. **Zest Kitchen & Bar** (Salt Lake City) — 4.5★, 1,308 reviews — plant-based menu, **and** this one actually has a matched SLCHD inspection record with a most recent inspection score of **0** (clean) — one of the few vegetable-focused spots in this list with verified inspection data.

**A caution:** Vessel Kitchen (Sandy location, veggie bowls) rates 4.6★ but its matched inspection history shows a recent score of 8 with **8 critical violations out of 48 total violations cited** — worth knowing if inspection cleanliness matters to you alongside the food itself.

**Overall caveat:** Like most establishments in this dataset, the vast majority of these vegetable-focused restaurants (all except Zest Kitchen & Bar and Vessel Kitchen) have **no matched SLCHD inspection history** in this data, so I can't confirm a clean or dirty record for them — the recommendation above is based purely on Google ratings/review volume, not verified food-safety inspections.

The chart shows these top 12 picks by rating, color-coded by city, so you can see both how they compare and where they're clustered (Salt Lake City proper has the densest concentration, with West Jordan and Millcreek also contributing standouts).

Table establishment_keys {
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [pk, note: 'NAME|ADDRESS|CITY']
  name varchar [not null]
  address varchar [not null]
  city varchar [not null]
  city_state_zip varchar
  establishment_type varchar
  source varchar [note: 'friend_slc | own_scrape']
  slchd_lat double
  slchd_lon double
  geocode_status varchar [note: 'Match | Match_Nominatim | No_Match | Tie']

  Note: 'SLCHD establishment list, one row per portal listing.'
}

Table category {
  category_id integer [pk]
  category varchar
}

Table establishments {
  gmap_id varchar [pk]
  name varchar
  address varchar
  description varchar
  geom geometry [note: 'ST_Point(longitude, latitude), spatial extension']
  avg_rating double
  num_of_reviews integer
  price varchar
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [ref: > establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_key, note: 'nullable; set when ER matched']

  Note: 'One row per Google Local place — all restaurants, not just SLCHD-matched.'
}

Table establishment_attributes {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  attribute varchar [not null]

  indexes { (gmap_id, attribute) [pk] }

  Note: 'Flattened meta.MISC leaf values. Outer category label (e.g. "Service options") dropped.'
}

Table establishment_categories {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  category_id integer [ref: > category.category_id, not null]

  indexes { (gmap_id, category_id) [pk] }
}

Table gmap_hours {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  day integer [not null, note: '0=Sun … 6=Sat']
  open_min bigint
  open_max bigint

  indexes { (gmap_id, day) [pk] }

  Note: 'Covers every meta place with parsable hours, not just the SLCHD-matched subset.'
}

Table review {
  user_id varchar
  name varchar
  time bigint
  rating double
  text varchar
  resp varchar
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id]
}

Table inspection_types {
  inspection_type_id integer [pk, note: 'parsed leading number, e.g. "01 - Routine" -> 1']
  description varchar [note: 'e.g. "Routine"']
}

Table inspections {
  inspection_id bigint [pk, increment]
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [ref: > establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_key, not null]
  inspection_date date [not null]
  inspection_type_id integer [ref: > inspection_types.inspection_type_id, note: 'nullable — 27 rows have no type']
  inspection_score integer

  Note: 'One row per inspection visit. count_critical/noncritical_violations dropped (derivable from violations).'
}

Table violation_codes {
  violation_code_id integer [pk, increment]
  code_text varchar [not null, note: 'base code, asterisks stripped, e.g. "4.5.18"']
  asterisk_count integer [not null, note: '0/1/2 trailing * in source, meaning unconfirmed']
  critical boolean [not null]
}

Table violations {
  violation_id bigint [pk, increment]
  inspection_id bigint [ref: > inspections.inspection_id, not null]
  violation_code_id integer [ref: > violation_codes.violation_code_id, not null]
  violation_description varchar [note: 'per-occurrence free text']
  violation_occurrences integer
  violation_cos boolean [note: 'corrected on site']
  violation_phr varchar [note: 'public health rationale']

  Note: 'One row per violation actually cited. Zero-violation inspections get zero rows (no placeholder row).'
}

## Halal food in Salt Lake County is genuinely hard to find — but what exists is well-regarded

**The numbers:**
- Only **9 establishments total** in the dataset carry the "Halal restaurant" category tag, and **8 of those are in Salt Lake County** (the 9th, Ali Baba Grill, is in St. George — Washington County, not Salt Lake).
- Against roughly **3,441 restaurants** located in Salt Lake County cities (Salt Lake City, West Valley City, South Jordan, Sandy, Murray, etc.), that's about **0.2%** of the local restaurant scene explicitly tagged halal.
- None of these 9 have a matched SLCHD inspection record in this dataset (`slchd_establishment_key` is null for all), so **no food-safety inspection history is available** for any halal-tagged establishment — I can't speak to their health inspection track record one way or the other.

**Where the options are (all in Salt Lake County):**
- Midnimo Restaurant (Salt Lake City) — 5.0★ (5 reviews)
- Kabul Kitchen (West Valley City) — 4.9★ (8 reviews)
- Global Place Somali Restaurant (Salt Lake City) — 4.9★ (418 reviews — the most-reviewed and most-established of the group)
- O'Falafel Middle Eastern Cuisine (Salt Lake City) — 4.6★ (968 reviews)
- Curry Corner Cafe (Salt Lake City) — 4.5★
- Bawarchi (South Jordan) — 4.4★
- Somali Restaurant/Nutrition & Ethnic Foods (West Valley City) — 4.4★
- Shahrazad Market and Restaurant (Salt Lake City) — 4.3★

**Takeaway:** Selection is very thin — under a dozen options countywide, clustered mainly around Salt Lake City and West Valley City with one further south in South Jordan — but every one of them rates 4.3★ or higher, several with hundreds of reviews (O'Falafel and Global Place Somali Restaurant in particular are well-established), so the few halal options that do exist are consistently well-liked. Note this reflects only restaurants explicitly categorized "Halal restaurant" in the source data — some Middle Eastern/Somali/Afghan spots not tagged that way may also serve halal food but wouldn't show up in this count.

WITH veg AS (

messages.content:
## Vegetable-forward picks in Salt Lake County

If you like vegetables, here are the highest-rated vegetarian/vegan-tagged spots in Salt Lake County (filtered to places with at least 40 reviews, so ratings are reliable):

1. **Buds** (Salt Lake City) — 4.9★, 818 reviews — tagged both vegetarian and vegan
2. **Cafe Shambala** (Salt Lake City) — 4.8★, 418 reviews — Tibetan/Himalayan, vegetarian-friendly
3. **Vegan Bowl** (West Jordan) — 4.8★, 628 reviews — build-your-own veggie/vegan bowls
4. **Rawtopia Living Cuisine and Beyond** (Millcreek) — 4.8★, 495 reviews — raw, plant-forward menu
5. **Curry Up Now** (Salt Lake City) — 4.8★, 148 reviews — Indian street food with strong veg options
6. **Mahider Ethiopian Restaurant & Market** (Salt Lake City) — 4.7★, 608 reviews — Ethiopian cuisine is naturally veggie-rich (lentils, greens, veggie combos)
7. **Sri Balaji Caffe** (West Jordan) — 4.7★, 398 reviews — South Indian vegetarian
8. **Diversion Social Eatery** (Salt Lake City) — 4.7★, 338 reviews
9. **CoreLife Eatery** (multiple SLC/Sandy locations) — 4.5–4.6★, 600–1,000+ reviews each — salad/grain-bowl chain, veggie-forward by design
10. **Zest Kitchen & Bar** (Salt Lake City) — 4.5★, 1,308 reviews — plant-based menu, **and** this one actually has a matched SLCHD inspection record with a most recent inspection score of **0** (clean) — one of the few vegetable-focused spots in this list with verified inspection data.

**A caution:** Vessel Kitchen (Sandy location, veggie bowls) rates 4.6★ but its matched inspection history shows a recent score of 8 with **8 critical violations out of 48 total violations cited** — worth knowing if inspection cleanliness matters to you alongside the food itself.

**Overall caveat:** Like most establishments in this dataset, the vast majority of these vegetable-focused restaurants (all except Zest Kitchen & Bar and Vessel Kitchen) have **no matched SLCHD inspection history** in this data, so I can't confirm a clean or dirty record for them — the recommendation above is based purely on Google ratings/review volume, not verified food-safety inspections.

The chart shows these top 12 picks by rating, color-coded by city, so you can see both how they compare and where they're clustered (Salt Lake City proper has the densest concentration, with West Jordan and Millcreek also contributing standouts).
